T-002.Title: Classify the candidate-lock permission-code open boundary and clean the candidateRoot fixtures

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In acquireCandidateLock (src/grace-cursor.ts), the exclusive create writeFileSync(lockPath, ..., { flag: "wx" }) no longer throws on a permission code. EPERM, EACCES, and EBUSY are classified as possible contention without changing the cooperation contract: when the holder is observable (observeCandidateLock returns a record), the contender takes the unchanged wait/reclaim path — known-live wait, known-dead reclaim, unknown-holder TTL, and the token/identity protection in reclaimCandidateLock all preserved — and revalidates and acquires; the shipped unobservable-EEXIST wait is unchanged; a permission code whose holder cannot be observed is retried a bounded number of times and then fails closed with the original error in bounded time, so a persistent unobservable denial cannot become an infinite wait. Any exported test seam this task adds is listed in the file's MODULE_MAP header, so the root lint inside bun run validate:ci stays green and leaves no markup.module-map-mismatch error. Durable tests under the existing "candidate lock primitive" describe inject the permission error immediately before the exclusive create and exercise the catch path: a live-holder contention waits and acquires; a persistent denial fails closed and bounded; an unobservable EEXIST holder is waited on; and a permission code whose holder exists but cannot be observed is bounded. Every contender is a bounded, reaped child process; directions with a releaser check its bounded exit, so a failed or withheld release cannot hang the run. The two unobservable-holder directions use a real unreadable lock record, capability-gated with a stated skip when the platform or an elevated runner cannot make it unreadable; and the live-holder and EEXIST-wait directions assert the contender genuinely held the lock it wrote, so a seam that returns without creating the lock cannot pass. The seam is test-only and leaves production behavior unchanged.

The candidateRoot fixture in src/grace-cursor.test.ts removes its temporary directories (rmSync of each created root), so the durable lock tests leave no temporary tree behind. Drive the red/green control: revert only the catch classification to the shipped if (code !== "EEXIST") throw and observe the live-holder contention direction reddens while the other three directions stay green; restore the classification and observe all four directions green.

T-005.Title: Guard the positive CI record and the URL-free bundle, then prepare the close

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add the positive guard in scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts. Resolve exactly this successor in active/ or archive/ and redden when it is absent from both or present in both. Read its ci-evidence.json and fail (zero-record is red, never green) when the sidecar is absent; when schemaVersion is not exactly 1.0.0; when candidateSha is missing, not a 40-character lowercase hex commit, not an ancestor of HEAD, or when any committed, staged, unstaged, deleted, renamed, or untracked path changed since candidateSha falls outside this successor's exact active and archive bundle directories and scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts; when runId is not a positive integer; when the jobs array lacks validate, dart-adapter, or windows-compatibility, repeats a job name or id, gives a conclusion other than success, a non-integer or negative tally, fail other than 0, or pass of 0; and when the directions array lacks a required Windows owner direction or gives a required direction a non-integer count, executed of 0, or skipped other than 0. The Linux-only AC-PIN-RELEASE-LIFETIME direction is outside the required set.

Compare candidateSha with the current working tree using git diff --no-renames --name-only <candidateSha> for tracked staged, unstaged, committed, deleted, and moved paths, plus git ls-files --others --exclude-standard for untracked paths. Both rename endpoints count; a forbidden workflow or source path moved into an allowed directory remains forbidden. Never exempt all of .ngrace/changes/. A forbidden difference forces a fresh user-pushed candidate run; this local path rule is a provenance check, not a claim that allowed bundle changes are invisible to Windows.

Scan every file of this successor bundle — spec.xml, plan.xml, design-context.xml, run.xml, run-ledger.xml, run/, and ci-evidence.json — in both its active and archived location, and fail when any contains a full GitHub Actions run or job link (an http or https scheme whose host is the GitHub web host and whose path reaches the Actions runs endpoint) in plain or XML-escaped form. The guard's own test plants, in throwaway copies, an absent sidecar; a sidecar with schemaVersion removed or wrong; a sidecar whose windows-compatibility conclusion is failure; a sidecar with one required direction's executed set to 0; a sidecar with a malformed tally; an uncommitted mutation of .github/workflows/validate.yml with src/ unchanged; a rename from a forbidden workflow or source path into an allowed bundle directory; a run-only link and a /job/ link in a temporary design-context.xml; and a full link in a temporary run-ledger.xml, asserting each reddens while clean evidence greens the guard. Recheck active and post-archive states in a faithful copy: the exact active sidecar scope path expands to this bundle's archive path at close. Drive selected baseline/target/final assertions and review on that copy and run the full-CI MustPassCommand once there. The fresh full Validate workflow at the final PR head is a post-archive release check, not a T-005 acceptance action: it can only run after the applied-archive commit exists and is pushed, and it must pass before PR merge, so it cannot be satisfied before T-005 closes.
